prompt: texinfo-format-region missing closing brace error message
answer:
`texinfo-format-region` reports **“Unbalanced parentheses”**, not “Unbalanced braces,” when it detects a missing closing brace. It treats brace mismatches as if they were parenthesis mismatches.

Example:

```tex
(@xref{Catching Mistakes, for more info.)
```

The command stops processing at or shortly after the detected error. To locate it, switch to the `*Info Region*` buffer; the cursor will be just after the error location.
